items.question: Is this suitable for my trade?
items.answer: Yes. The system is built to fit any tradesperson who issues quotes — renovation contractors, electricians, plumbers, painters, carpenters and more.

items.question: Can I try it for free?
items.answer: Yes, you can start on the free plan with no credit card and create up to 5 quotes per month.

items.question: How does the customer receive the quote?
items.answer: You send a unique link via WhatsApp, email, or any other channel. The customer opens the quote in their browser, can download a PDF, and accept or reject it.

items.question: Can I change the VAT rate?
items.answer: Yes, the VAT rate can be updated in Settings at any time, so quotes always stay accurate.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Yes. Your data is encrypted and fully isolated from other businesses on the platform. We never store credit card details.
